content:
Chapter 100 Absolute Control Is The Most Loving (Please Subscribe)

First of all, as a simple and effective method, the most direct way is for Zhong Yu to directly select some geniuses with extremely high talents who have not undergone any cultivation, and inject a trace of his special true energy directly before they cultivate.

Let them directly have a trace of their own internal strength without having to go through experience, save the process of condensing, just need to keep practicing and let this fellow's internal strength develop and grow!

And the inner strength that Zhong Yu bestows on them is very pure, which is not much purer than the ordinary inner strength, and also has a supreme special attribute, which can be used to fight with the enemy, and can also have some suppression of infuriating degree, which can be described as powerful. Incomparable!

However, there are some hidden dangers for things obtained through others! In particular, this thing was given by the most selfish emperor in the world. Can you expect that emperor to be really selfless and give benefits to a trivial ordinary person?

Zhong Yu has absolute control over the infuriating energy that Zhong Yu gave them at the very core. As long as there is a need, Zhong Yu can recapture the infuriating energy he sent out at any time and bring it back under his control.

And those soldiers are like the tenants who farm the fields for Zhong Yu, give you a young seedling, let you slowly grow into mature rice, and then see how the landlord treats and values you?

If you think that you are a good race, you can keep planting, and you will continue to plant more and more. Those soldiers who have continuously improved their realm and strength through cultivation, relying on these things to gain their status and honor, just It is equivalent to the wages that the landlord (Zhong Yu) gave them!

If the crops are not good enough to make Zhong Yu dissatisfied, then you can directly drive them away (remove), take back the land that was rented to them (take back the qi), and make them nothing (after losing the qi) power, and became a mortal again), it all depends on Zhong Yu's mind?

With Zhong Yu's mind full of imperial thoughts, he naturally wanted to choose this method so that he could control everything and rule over all his subordinates, so that they would not have the slightest ability to resist, and could only allow themselves to slaughter and slaughter them. go play.

But this is destined to be impossible. First of all, he doesn't have so much time to let the soldiers at the bottom grow into a strong man, and follow him step by step to conquer the heavens and the world without falling behind because of his strength!

Secondly, even if he has so much time, he can't guarantee that all those soldiers can become strong. If one of them can become a real god among tens of thousands of people, he will be secretly happy.

You must know that in this main world, all the intelligent creatures in the entire continent add up to tens of billions of him, but every new god that is born can only be separated by hundreds of years!

There are still many creatures born in such hundreds of years. It is because of the fall of the old god and the split of the godhead that these relatively weak new gods were born!

That's because the beliefs on the mainland have long been divided by those old gods without shuffling. How could those old gods divide their rations and give them to those new gods who didn't know them?

If you don't take the lead in killing those new gods who want to grab the cake with you, you are already considered the old gods with integrity and morality!

The second is to slowly conquer the heavens and the world, spread your influence to one world after another, and constantly corrode the heaven and humanity of that world.

In this way, the powerhouses of that world, under the influence of their own subtle influences in the whole world, slowly stamp their own marks on their minds (the perception of heaven) and the power in their bodies (humanity and luck).

As a result, to a certain extent, he has a certain authority over their power, and when he wants to deal with them, he can suddenly take action, disrupting the movement of their internal power and the clarity of their minds, so as to achieve the effect of surprise and defeating the enemy in one fell swoop.

As for the third type, it is the most simple and rude to put restrictions on them, or force them to sacrifice their most fundamental true spirits and souls, so as to directly control their lives.

But this method is undoubtedly very demoralizing, and it is easy to cause dissatisfaction and resentment among the subordinates, that is, it is easy to cause rebellion, and the scourge is too great, far less secret and easy to use than the first two methods. Zhong Yu is absolutely necessary unless necessary. Will not use this method!

And Zhong Yu used the first method for the 50,000 soldiers who had the talent for cultivation that he had selected by himself.

Let them develop and grow by themselves, slowly affecting their entire body and mind, and subtly instill the idea of loyalty to themselves!

In this way, those soldiers slowly become their puppets, but still retain their own thoughts and thinking, and make them think that they want to be loyal to themselves. This kind of silent effect is exactly what they want!

For this reason, Zhong Yu was delayed in the rear for a whole month. Every day, he had to separate out his true energy and put it into the bodies of those soldiers. This was a huge task!

But it has been said before that the infuriating energy of the Central Territory is not as strong as those of the fourth-order, and even the deep third-order is inferior to some foundations. How can it afford such a heavy task? !

With Zhong Yu's skill, he can divide his infuriating energy into extremely slender filaments, and at most he can only divide him into more than a thousand filaments. For most of the huge numbers reaching 50,000, it is simply a drop in the bucket!

And after the infuriating energy is separated, Zhong Yu will also fall into a period of weakness, and if he wants to cultivate again, it is absolutely impossible to rely on his own ability without him for a few months.

The reason why he was able to distribute the qi to a whole army of 50,000 people in this short one month, and completed this huge amount of work, the magic weapon of winning is to directly let the system use qi to exchange the qi in his body. , so as to achieve the effect of rapid air return.

However, the consumption of these infuriating qi is also extremely terrifying. If you want to recover once, although it is not as terrifying as a day of training, you need 1/10 of the qi luck value to go back and forth.

Now that he is in the first stage of Xiaocheng realm cultivation, he needs 1000 qi for one day of cultivation, 1/10 of this thousand is 100, and 30 days is 3000 qi, which is enough for Zhongyu to practice. It's been three days.

For Zhong Yu, who is currently in short supply of luck, it is equivalent to the luck points obtained by his army in the Eder Tribe Alliance, killing tens of thousands of barbarians, and the death of his own army. A portion of the total air transport is recycled by the system.

After the death of the army he exchanged, he could recover half or less of his luck points depending on the situation on the spot. Cao Cao's people said that the random temptation regardless of loss is because those soldiers can still recover up to half of his luck points when they die.

In this way, although I still feel a little distressed about the luck points lost by the deaths of the soldiers, it is not so distressing to be able to recover some of them, and it is within the range that Zhong Yu can accept.

But if there are any generals? A large number of soldiers and horses have been lost meaninglessly, and Zhong Yu doesn't mind letting them see what it means to be a king's moody, accompanying the king is like accompanying a tiger, not something the ancients said casually!
